name: english-writing
description: Write and fix English text so that it reads naturally and adds nothing the original does not say, with the patterns of blader/humanizer, rules for phrasing translated from Japanese, short sentences, and terms, and scripts that point at suspect lines

interface.longDescription: Writes and fixes English issues, pull requests, commit messages, READMEs, documentation, and replies to outside projects so that they read naturally and mean one thing, without adding facts, numbers, names, or claims the original does not hold. It follows the patterns of AI-sounding prose in blader/humanizer, copied unchanged, and adds this plugin's rules: the project's own guide comes first, phrasing translated word for word from Japanese is rewritten in the English order, a sentence keeps to 25 words, each thing keeps one name, and each fix is named with its kind and explained in your language. A script of its own points at long sentences, passive voice, and phrasing translated from Japanese, and proselint points at set phrases and weasel words. Both run on your machine and never send your text anywhere; proselint runs through uv, which downloads it on first use.
defaultPrompt: Make this English text natural without adding anything
